ONE KNOB: recon_sample_steps (T, DDIM reverse-step count = NFE) 56->72 (+29% finer DDIM grid); val_n 96->72 evenly-spaced is the BUDGET-SIZING co-move (box 5, the single authorized (B) val_n exception to hold the HARD 1200s wall, guarded ABOVE the ~60 floor), NOT a hypothesis variable. BASE = iter-7 (BEST SSIM 0.8711): recon_dc_solver=cg, recon_dcstep_every=5, recon_dcstep_n_cg=3, recon_dcstep_warmup=5, recon_dcstep_relax=1.0, recon_eta=5.0, recon_init=fbp, recon_eta_clamp=false ALL UNCHANGED. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (200 train slices, NO retrain; unconstrained=200-slice misnomer from the demo-dl phantom regime, NOT a leakage variant). The (A) DC-step CG fix landed iter-6 (biggest A-fix gain on this variant: soft-DPS best 0.3960 -> CG-DC 0.8241); the (B) v5 EMA DDPM retrain (part ii) is NOT ready -- this iter changes ONLY the NFE knob. TRAJECTORY (val L277, 321px detector-geometry FOV, LD-FBP floor 0.8078): iter-1 T25/eta30/every0 SSIM 0.3688/hr0; iter-2 eta30->5 0.3960 (best soft); iter-3 T25->32 0.3869; iter-4 every0->5 LEGACY hard-DC 0.0553 (collapse); iter-5 T->40 soft 0.3709; iter-6 recon_dc_solver=cg CG-DC 0.8241/PSNR27.15 (A-fix); iter-7 T40->56 0.8711/PSNR29.82 (BEST, NFE +0.047). NFE is the STRONGEST SSIM climber of any solver in the campaign (0.8241->0.8711 on +40% NFE) and monotone on the CG-DC path. LIMITER: regime-bounded on DENSE 2304-view rebinned Mayo -- LD-FBP near-complete so hr>0 is unlikely from a finer grid; the v4-prior payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks. For SSIM the limiter is the coarseness of the T=56 DDIM reverse schedule (the remaining soft lever). HYPOTHESIS: a finer DDIM reverse schedule (T 56->72, +29% NFE) lets the CG-DC iterate relax further onto the sino-consistent mode, lifting SSIM modestly above iter-7 BEST 0.8711 -- predicted 0.875-0.885, hr STAYS 0 (regime-bound). NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.8711 (flat-or-down vs iter-7) at T=72, the NFE lever has SATURATED on the CG-DC path; file it, unconstrained best stays iter-7 (SSIM 0.8711, hr 0), and any further NFE payoff is reserved for the SPARSE benchmarks. BUDGET (HARD 20-min=1200s wall, val=evenly-spaced L277): iter-7 ran 1078.7s at T=56/val_n=96 = 11.236 s/slice = 0.20064 s/slice/step (CG-DC cost ~linear in T since both DDIM steps and every-5 CG triggers scale with T). At T=72: 72*0.20064 = 14.446 s/slice; val_n=72 -> 72*14.446 = 1040s = 17.3 min < 1200s (~160s headroom). val_n=96 at T=72 would be 1387s=23.1min (BLOWS the wall); val_n=80 = 1156s=19.3min (too tight, 44s headroom), so val_n=72 is the budget mechanism that unlocks the +29% NFE probe while staying comfortably ABOVE the ~60 val_n floor (72 slices = a representative metric), evenly-spaced across the 214-slice L277 volume (protocol-sanctioned when val_n<214). If the next NFE step (T->~90) would push val_n below ~60, hold T and confirm saturation. HARD-WIRED: staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps single-val-ps probe, bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov=False), recon_dc_solver=cg. reuse ddpm_mayo_unconstrained_v4.pt (NO retrain).
